# Psalm 128 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 128:1 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** A-song of-the-ascents. Blessed every-one fearing YHWH, the-walker in-his-ways.
- **LOGOS:** A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways!
- **PNEUMA:** A song for the journey to Jerusalem. How happy is everyone who honors the LORD and lives by his ways!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 128:2 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** The-labor-of your-hands indeed you-will-eat; blessed you and-good to-you.
- **LOGOS:** You shall eat the fruit of the labor of your hands; you shall be blessed, and it shall be well with you.
- **PNEUMA:** You will enjoy the fruit of your own hard work — you will be happy, and things will go well for you.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** The LORD bless you from Zion! May you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** That's the blessing waiting for the person who honors the LORD.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 128:3 (overlap: 11%)

- **EMET:** Your-wife like-a-vine fruitful in-recesses-of your-house; your-children like-shoots-of olives around your-table.
- **LOGOS:** Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
- **PNEUMA:** Your wife will be like a fruitful grapevine, flourishing in your home. Your children will be like young olive trees clustered around your table.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** May you see your children's children! Peace be upon Israel!
